model.distance_model: mu_reference=25+5 log10(Vcmb_km_s / H_reference), with CMB-frame reported group Vcmb, not local source redshift
model.measurement_model: one raw method SN Ia modulus per group, sigma_i=e_DMsnIa release; optional independent peculiar velocity scenario sigma_mag=(5/ln10)sigma_v/Vcmb
model.shared_calibration: eta~N(0,tau^2) counterfactual prior; tau not inferred from these selected data
model.gauge: for unanchored eta and unanchored Hscale, only eta-5log10(H/Href) identified; profiling eta gives H-invariant objective
model.selection_counterfactual: for demonstration only, independent per-slot *method modulus* [31,35.6] mag truncation; NOT actual historical DMzp eligibility 31..35; both shared preselection and slot-conditioning coherent but DIFFERENT sampling experiments
physical_full_law_required: individual survey-source eligibility conditioned on raw observations, not the published resultant DMzp
